title: My tasks
description: Tasks, approvals and the steps every order passes through.

handed.title: Waiting for you
handed.description: These came to you personally, so only you can see them here.

reason.escalated: {{name}} cannot act and no substitute is available, so this came to you.
reason.passed-on: {{name}} passed this on to you, because it is above their limit.
reason.named: {{name}} raised this, and you are named as their approver.

handed.cannotDecide: Your role cannot decide this yet. An administrator can give it the permission.
handed.cannotOpen: Your role cannot open or decide this yet. An administrator can give it the permissions.

inbox.heading: Task inbox
inbox.ownDescription: The steps waiting on you, most urgent first.
inbox.otherDescription: You can look at any role's inbox. Pick one.
inbox.emptyDescription: Nothing needs this role right now. New tasks appear here as orders move.
inbox.noInboxTitle: Your role has no task inbox
inbox.noInboxDescription: Ask for the permission to open other roles' inboxes, or sign in as a role that has tasks.

forYou.title: Sent to you
forYou.description: Reminders and escalations on tasks still open. They clear when the task is done.
forYou.show_one: Show the reminder sent to you
forYou.show_other: Show the {{count}} reminders sent to you

reminders.heading: Reminders
reminders.description: What is due, who has been told, and where it goes if nobody acts.
reminders.emptyDescription: Reminders appear here when a task is close to its due date.

order.heading: Order {{orderNo}}
order.navisionNote: {{orderNo}} is Business Central's sales order number.
order.stepsDescription: Where the order is on its way. The steps come from sample data for the demo.
order.timelineEmpty: Nothing has happened to this order yet.
order.notFoundTitle: This order is not in the sample data
order.notFoundDescription: Check the order number, or go back to My tasks.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.description: The prepayment asked for and what Finance has confirmed.

form.heading: Confirm a payment
form.invalid: Fill in every field. The amount must be more than zero.

spr.heading: Stock purchase requisition {{recordNo}}
spr.descriptionSuggested: Suggested by the stock check of {{orderNo}} on {{date}}, for {{name}} to raise.
spr.basisDescription: Spectra raises an SPR from stock on hand and the last three months' sales. The suggested quantity covers this order's shortfall: inventory, minus what sales orders hold, plus what is on order.
spr.fieldsDescription: Suggested values are the system's proposal. They are not final until you approve.
spr.approverDescription: As Spectra described it on 5 Nov: a coordinator routes each SPR, and any one of three management approvers decides.
spr.anyOfThree: Any one of three management approvers
spr.waiting: Waiting for a management approver. Any one of the three decides, and the decision shows here.
spr.passedOn: Above the limit: {{by}} passed this on to {{name}} on {{date}}. It is waiting for their decision.
spr.passedToYou: {{by}} passed this on to you on {{date}}, because it is above their limit. They would have marked it {{asked}}.
spr.notRunnable: This is a sample from the demo data, so it is not decided here. An SPR the workflow runs is decided on this page.

toast.passedOn: {{ref}} is above your limit, so it went to {{name}}

spr.commentHint: Say why. The comment is kept with the decision.
spr.commentRequired: Write a comment before you decide.
spr.readOnly: Your role can read this request but not decide it.
spr.handedNoPermission: Your role cannot decide this yet, so it stays waiting until an administrator gives it the permission.
spr.notFoundTitle: This request is not in the sample data
spr.notFoundDescription: Check the number, or go back to My tasks.
spr.nextStep: When you approve, the product manager places the vendor PO in Business Central.

history.overdue: Waiting for a decision, overdue since {{date}}
history.backToRaise: Back with {{name}} to correct and raise again

raise.heading: Not raised yet
raise.intro: OrderPilot worked this SPR out from the stock check. Check it, then raise it: it goes to the management approvers, and any one of them decides.
raise.introAgain: Correct what the approver asked for, then raise it again. It goes back to the management approvers.
raise.others: The product manager has not raised this SPR yet, so it has not gone to the approvers.
raise.othersAgain: It is back with the product manager to correct and raise again.
raise.done: {{ref}} raised and sent to the approvers
raise.failed: The SPR was not raised. Reload the page and try again.
